html:
The Mbara are an Aboriginal people of inland north Queensland, west of the Great Dividing Range.

They spoke the Mbara language, part of the Pama-Nyungan family. Neighbours on the map include the Yirandali to the south, the Mayi-Kulan to the west and the Gugu Badhun to the east. Pastoral runs spread into this country in the 1860s. Little else is recorded about them. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Mbara are an Aboriginal people of inland north Queensland, west of the Great Dividing Range.
